question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -3 \\ 5\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-8 \\ 9 \\ -17\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -3 \\ 5\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-8 \\ 9 \\ -17\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-8 \\ 9 \\ -17\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-8 \\ 9 \\ -17\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} &=-8 \\ -2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=9 \\ 3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=-17\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $2$ and adding the result to the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} &=-7\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=-7$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=9 \\ -2{x}_{1}-3(-7) &=9 \\ -2{x}_{1} &=-12 \\ {x}_{1} &=6\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=6$ and ${x}_{2}=-7$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=-17 \\ 3(6)+5(-7) &=-17 \\ -17 &=-17\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=6$ and ${x}_{2}=-7$, which means

$$
6{a}_{1}-7{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(6)+(-7)=-1.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ -23 \\ -14\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}5{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ -23 \\ -14\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ -23 \\ -14\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=0 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=-23 \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-14\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $3$, the second equation by $2$, and adding the resulting equations, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}23{x}_{2} &=-46 \\ {x}_{2} &=-2\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=-2$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=-23 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4(-2) &=-23 \\ 3{x}_{1} &=-15 \\ {x}_{1} &=-5\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2}=-2$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-14 \\ 4(-5)-3(-2) &=-14 \\ -14 &=-14\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2}=-2$, which means

$$
-5{a}_{1}-2{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-5)+(-2)=-7.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-9 \\ -7 \\ 22\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-9 \\ -7 \\ 22\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-9 \\ -7 \\ 22\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-9 \\ -7 \\ 22\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-9 \\ -{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-7 \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=22\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Adding the first and the second equations we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} &=-16 \\ {x}_{2} &=8\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=8$ into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-9 \\ {x}_{1}-(8) &=-9 \\ {x}_{1} &=-1 \\ {x}_{1} &=-1\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2}=8$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=22 \\ 2(-1)+3(8) &=22 \\ 22 &=22\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2}=8$, which means

$$
-{a}_{1}+8{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-1)+(8)=7.
$$

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-6 \\ -{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=2 \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=-2\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Adding the first and the second equations we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} &=-4 \\ {x}_{2} &=2\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=2$ into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-6 \\ {x}_{1}-(2) &=-6 \\ {x}_{1} &=-4 \\ {x}_{1} &=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-4$ and ${x}_{2}=2$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=-2 \\ 2(-4)+3(2) &=-2 \\ -2 &=-2\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-4$ and ${x}_{2}=2$, which means

$$
-4{a}_{1}+2{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-4)+(2)=-2.
$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}24 \\ 10 \\ -20\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}5{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}24 \\ 10 \\ -20\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}24 \\ 10 \\ -20\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=24 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=10 \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-20\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $3$, the second equation by $2$, and adding the resulting equations, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}23{x}_{2} &=92 \\ {x}_{2} &=4\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=4$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=10 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4(4) &=10 \\ 3{x}_{1} &=-6 \\ {x}_{1} &=-2\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-2$ and ${x}_{2}=4$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-20 \\ 4(-2)-3(4) &=-20 \\ -20 &=-20\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-2$ and ${x}_{2}=4$, which means

$$
-2{a}_{1}+4{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-2)+(4)=2.
